nodes.label: Why MeSH Alone Is Always Wrong
nodes.rationale: Indexing lag, descriptor drift, absent descriptors and indexer disagreement mean the most recent 6-12 months — usually the part the user cares about — is reachable only by text words. Consequence: every concept facet is (MeSH OR text-word).

nodes.label: E-utilities Field Tags and Filters
nodes.rationale: [dp] is unstable for ahead-of-print records while [edat] is stable and makes a rerun reproducible, so the date type used is logged in query_string. Sample size, funding and setting are not queryable and are applied at screening.

nodes.label: Validated Design Hedges (Cochrane HSSS, SIGN)
nodes.rationale: The animal exclusion must be NOT (Animals[mh] NOT Humans[mh]) — plain NOT Animals[mh] drops every mixed human/animal record. Filters are re-verified against canonical sources before systematic/max runs and never presented as verbatim published ones when adapted.

nodes.label: Null/Negative-Findings Hedge
nodes.rationale: Not optional: it is the operationalization of the invariant that null and negative findings are actively searched for rather than whatever happens to surface.

nodes.label: Citation Chaining (elink)
nodes.rationale: A different entry point, not another boolean query — it finds papers whose wording the vocabulary missed. Chaining amplifies the seed set's citation bias, so seeds must be at least three independent records including one null-result paper. Chaining that is not logged does not exist.

nodes.label: Orthogonal Query Design (four axes)
nodes.rationale: Prevents eight queries that are one query with synonyms shuffled, producing one hit set, ~0% marginal yield, and a search log that only looks thorough. Orthogonality is a property of hit sets, not strings: two queries must differ on 2+ axes AND satisfy Jaccard < 0.6 with >=15% unique yield.

nodes.label: Hit-Set Overlap Report (overlap.py)
nodes.rationale: Jaccard alone is insufficient — date-slicing scores J=0 while adding no new concepts — so the axis profile must differ too and both tests must pass. Remediation replaces a failing query's axis value rather than deleting it, since deleting shrinks the recorded strategy without improving it.

nodes.label: Query Execution and Logging Contract (L1-L7)
nodes.rationale: Reading translated_query is mandatory before accepting a result: it reveals truncation that suppressed term mapping, a mistyped [mh] that silently mapped to [tw], and unintended explosion. A count:0 query is still logged — zero hits is a result.
